en: Gallium is a solid metal at room temperature but melts into a liquid when held in your bare hand.
The Statue of Liberty is green because its copper surface underwent a chemical change, reacting with oxygen to form copper carbonate.
A mixture of cornstarch and water acts like a liquid when poured slowly but becomes a solid when you punch it.
Water is one of the very few substances on Earth that expands and becomes less dense when it freezes into solid ice.
Most of the visible universe, including all the stars in the night sky, is made of a superheated state of matter called plasma.
Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide that undergoes sublimation, turning directly into a cold gas without ever becoming a liquid first.
Mayonnaise is a stable mixture of oil and vinegar where egg yolk acts as an emulsifier to keep the liquids from separating.
Water strider insects can walk on pond water because the liquid's high surface tension creates an invisible, elastic-like skin on top.
Mixing baking soda and vinegar creates a rapid chemical change that produces carbon dioxide gas, which forms the bubbles you see.
Honey is a supersaturated solution containing more dissolved sugar than water can normally hold at room temperature without crystallizing.
Aerogel is a solid material made by replacing the liquid in a gel with gas, making it 99 percent empty space.
Heating white sugar causes a chemical change called caramelization, transforming the clear crystals into a brown liquid with a completely new flavor.
